answer.body:
@bbhxwl I guess you can do it by using dependency injection or scopes, although, I'm not sure if it's as convenient as in C#, but it's still not much more code to write. Again, you should read the documentation.

https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/dependencies/
https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/security/oauth2-scopes/

Also, consider reading the code of the full-stack template: https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template

I hope it's helpful for you.
